name: date-night
description: A short, low-poly, GTA-flavoured driving-and-dialogue game made as a personal gift.

scripts.zip: vite build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');execSync(process.platform==='win32'?'powershell -NoProfile -Command Compress-Archive -Force -Path dist/* -DestinationPath date-night-dist.zip':'cd dist && zip -qr ../date-night-dist.zip .',{stdio:'inherit'})"
